pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, multi-lobed dark regions with jagged, stellate margins and sharp pixel gradients at the boundaries. The patches show significant variation in geometry, appearing as interlocking polygons with complex, non-linear edges.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous lattice of light-colored negative space. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial and quadri-radial. The pixel thickness of the pathways is relatively consistent across the mid-flank, narrowing slightly toward the dorsal ridge.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette corresponding to the mane is visible along the upper neck and shoulder against the background.
